variants.title: ZS-042 breakout (DS3231 + AT24C32 EEPROM + CR2032 holder)

notes.text: ZS-042 boards (DS3231 + AT24C32 + CR2032 holder) are widely reported to charge the backup cell from VCC through a resistor and diode; with a non-rechargeable CR2032 remove that path or fit a rechargeable cell.
ZS-042 boards carry an AT24C32 EEPROM on the same bus, reported at 0x57 (A0–A2 pulled up on the board); add it as its own part (module at24c32) so address conflicts (e.g. MAX30102 0x57) are checked.
ZS-042 boards are reported to carry 4.7 kΩ pull-ups on SDA/SCL to VCC: at VCC 5 V they pull the ESP32 bus to 5 V. Power the board from 3.3 V or record facts.pullups_to.
